Renee (CS): starting a short thread to draft a compact customer-facing runbook: ‘graduated ramp’ for caching/batching/streaming + a renewal-health checklist. want it to be usable by CS and copy-pastable by customers. ideas?

Omar (SE): keep it operational. propose 3 stages: PRELAUNCH, RAMP, STEADY. each stage has 3 actions.
PRELAUNCH: smoke top-10 prompts, set prefill=true, set pref_ttl to match session window (default 600s).
RAMP: start with conservative batching (initial=3, max=10), enable modest jitter (50-75ms), run 30m warm pool.
STEADY: increase max_batch_size if latency stable; set caching eviction aligned to user session length.

Jules (CS): for renewals, include a small ‘health snapshot’ customers can export: med latency, p95, cache_hit_pct, monthly cost delta. recommend a one-slide chart for renewals showing before/after tuning.

Nikhil (Product): suggest an automated renewal-risk score. sample inputs + weights: cache_hit_change_24h (40%), p95_latency_change_24h (30%), streaming_error_spike_6h (20%), customer-reported-latency (10%). threshold: score > 0.6 => high-touch outreach. add as internal tag: renewal_risk:auto.

Omar (SE): practical YAML we can hand to customers (copyable):
```
# onboarding recommended defaults
prefill: true
prefill_ttl_seconds: 600  # tune to session length
batching:
  initial_batch_size: 3
  max_batch_size: 10
  jitter_ms: 75
streaming:
  enable_streaming: true
  partial_retry_limit: 2
  heartbeat_interval_ms: 250
```

Renee (CS): short, customer-facing TL;DR to put at top: "TL;DR: run the preflight, enable prefill for bursts, start small on batching, capture three prompts, and send us the exported health snapshot at day 3."

Jules (CS): feedback capture plan (customer survey): Day0 (within 24h): one-question net-ok: "Did latency meet expectations?" (yes/no). Day3: 3-question form (latency ok? errors seen? paste 3 critical prompts). Day14: open text feedback + ask to attach examples of poor completions. Store responses on account record.

Nikhil (Product): observability queries — using plain SQL-style for docs teams who want quick checks (not raw promql):
- cache hit pct last 24h: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(cache_hits) / NULLIF(SUM(cache_requests),0) FROM metrics WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours';
- p95 latency last 1h: SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) FROM request_latency WHERE ts > now() - interval '1 hour';
Mention these are illustrative; link to Grafana dashboards.

Omar (SE): debugging tips for cold-tail issues:
- run with jitter_ms=0 for an isolated 10-minute test to see raw concurrency behavior
- temporarily reduce initial_batch_size to 1 to isolate batching effects
- enable tracing for a narrow window and collect top slow traces

Renee (CS): internal handoff checklist (CS -> SE) before flipping to live:
- CS: collect top-10 prompts + attach to account
- SE: confirm dashboard panels (median, p95, cache_hit_pct, avg_batch_size, stream_error_rate)
- Joint 30-min smoke: CS drives prompts, SE watches traces, both sign-off in ticket
- Tag account with renewal_risk:auto=true if health score high

Jules (CS): escalation playbook mapping:
- Immediate page: p95 latency > SLA + 300ms for 30m OR stream_error_rate > 3x baseline in 1h
- CS-led triage within 2h: cache_hit_pct drop > 30% in 6h OR customer survey reports errors
- Non-urgent follow-up: persistent small regressions flagged in weekly health email

InfraBot: saved template: "Graduated Ramp — CS Runbook: caching, batching, streaming" (created by Renee).

Nikhil (Product): fallback guidance to include: prefer graceful degrade over outage. example routing rules: if primary model variant errors > 1% for 10m, route 100% of traffic to smaller compatible variant and label the incident. auto-notify CS and mark account with temporary fallback flag.

Renee (CS): copy for customers about costs: "Tip: enable prefill to improve latency for bursts; measure monthly token spend before/after batching to show unit-cost wins. We can help create the snapshot for your renewal deck."

Omar (SE): small note for SEs: avoid enabling aggressive model quantization mid-trial. require a quality eval run (A/B) before rolling to production.

Jules (CS): final action items:
- Renee: produce 1-page runbook + 2-slide renewal snapshot template (ETA: tomorrow morning)
- Omar: add YAML to onboarding repo and provide copy link (ETA: 24h)
- Nikhil: wire a renewal_risk:auto label into the console alerts (ETA: next sprint)

Renee (CS): thanks team — i'll post the draft here once ready. :thumbsup:
